source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 21 (PDF 75-87), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 21 (Halogenoalkanes) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a halogenoalkane? How are halogenoalkanes classified on the basis of the number of halogen atoms?
(Halogenoalkane kya hai? Halogen atoms ki tadaad ki bunyad par in ki taqseem kaise hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab alkane ke aik ya zyada hydrogen atoms halogen atoms se badal jayein to halogenoalkane banta hai. Halogen atoms ki tadaad ke mutabiq yeh mono, di, tri ya poly halogenoalkane hota hai.

book_ref.quote: is formed when one or more hydrogen atoms of an alkane are replaced by halogen atoms

blocks.prompt:
2 What are alkyl halides? Write their general formula and explain its symbols.
(Alkyl halides kya hain? In ka general formula likh kar symbols samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Monohalogenoalkanes ko alkyl halides kehte hain. General formula: R – X, jahan R alkyl group (methyl, ethyl, propyl waghaira) aur X halogen atom (F, Cl, Br, I) hai.

book_ref.quote: Their general formula is R – X

blocks.prompt:
3 Define a secondary halogenoalkane and give two examples.
(Secondary halogenoalkane ki definition likhein aur do misaalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Secondary halogenoalkane woh hai jis mein halogen aise carbon se jura ho jo seedha do doosre carbon atoms se jura ho. Misaalein: 2-chloropropane, CH₃–CHCl–CH₃, aur 2-chlorobutane, CH₃–CHCl–CH₂–CH₃.

book_ref.quote: Secondary halogenoalkanes are those in which the halogen atom is attached with a carbon atom

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between primary and tertiary halogenoalkanes with one example of each.
(Primary aur tertiary halogenoalkanes mein farq likhein, har aik ki misaal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation: Farq us carbon atom mein hai jis par halogen laga hai:

book_ref.quote: In a primary halogenoalkane, the halogen atom is attached with a carbon

rows: Halogen wala carbon aik ya kisi carbon se nahi jura
Halogen wala carbon seedha teen carbon atoms se jura
Misaal: CH₃–CH₂–Cl (chloroethane)
Misaal: (CH₃)₃C–Cl (2-chloro-2-methylpropane)
SN2 (aur E2) follow karta hai
SN1 (aur E1) follow karta hai

blocks.prompt:
5 On what basis are monohalogenoalkanes classified as primary, secondary and tertiary? Classify CH₃CH₂CH₂Br.
(Monohalogenoalkanes ko primary, secondary aur tertiary mein kis bunyad par taqseem kiya jata hai? CH₃CH₂CH₂Br ki qisam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Taqseem halogen wale carbon ki qisam par hai, yani us se seedha kitne carbon jure hain (aik ya koi nahi: primary; do: secondary; teen: tertiary). CH₃CH₂CH₂Br mein C–Br wala carbon aik carbon se jura hai, is liye primary (1-bromopropane).

book_ref.quote: Monohalogenoalkane or alkyl halides are further classified into primary, secondary and tertiary

blocks.prompt:
6 What is halothane? Why has it replaced chloroform as an anesthetic?
(Halothane kya hai? Is ne anesthetic ke tor par chloroform ki jagah kyun li?)
blocks.explanation: Halothane (CF₃–CHClBr) aik halogenated hydrocarbon hai jo taaqatwar inhalation anesthetic hai; surgery mein waqti behoshi laata hai. Pehle chloroform aur doosri chlorinated anesthetics istemal hoti theen jo ab zehreelay pan aur hifazati khadshat ki wajah se mamnoo hain.

book_ref.quote: Halothane is a halogenated hydrocarbon widely used as a powerful inhalation anesthetic

blocks.prompt:
7 Give two uses of halogenoalkanes in daily life. What compounds are replacing CFCs?
(Rozmarra zindagi mein halogenoalkanes ke do istemal batayein. CFCs ki jagah kaun se compounds aa rahe hain?)
blocks.explanation: Istemal: halogenated compounds taaqatwar anesthetics hain (maslan halothane), aur PVC (piping) aur PTFE/Teflon (non-stick bartan) jaise polymers ke intermediates hain. CFCs jo refrigerants aur aerosol propellants thay, ab hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) se badle ja rahe hain jin mein chlorine nahi. Freons khud CFCs hain (Freon-12 = CCl₂F₂).

book_ref.quote: Freons are themselves chlorofluorocarbons

blocks.prompt:
8 How is chloroethane prepared from ethane? Write the equation.
(Ethane se chloroethane kaise banaya jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Roshni ki maujoodgi mein alkane ki halogenation se:
CH₃–CH₃ + Cl₂ —(light)→ CH₃–CH₂–Cl + HCl

book_ref.quote: Halogenoalkanes can be prepared by the halogenation of alkanes in the presence of light

blocks.prompt:
9 How can bromoethane be prepared from an alkene? Name the type of reaction.
(Alkene se bromoethane kaise banaya ja sakta hai? Reaction ki qisam ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ethene par hydrogen bromide ki electrophilic addition se:
H₂C=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CH₂–Br

book_ref.quote: electrophilic addition of hydrogen halides to alkenes

blocks.prompt:
10 How is ethanol converted into chloroethane using a halogen acid? Give the role of ZnCl₂.
(Halogen acid ke zariye ethanol ko chloroethane mein kaise badla jata hai? ZnCl₂ ka kirdar batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ethanol ko ZnCl₂ (catalyst) ki maujoodgi mein HCl ke saath react karaya jata hai:
CH₃–CH₂–OH + HCl —(ZnCl₂)→ CH₃–CH₂–Cl + H₂O

book_ref.quote: Alcohols may be converted to the corresponding alkyl halides by the action of halogen acid

blocks.prompt:
11 Write the reaction of ethanol with thionyl chloride. Why is this method especially useful?
(Ethanol ka thionyl chloride ke saath reaction likhein. Yeh tareeqa khaas tor par mufeed kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃–CH₂–OH + SOCl₂ —(pyridine)→ CH₃–CH₂–Cl + SO₂ + HCl
Yeh mufeed hai kyun ke dono by-products, SO₂ aur HCl, gases hain jo nikal jati hain aur khalis product bachta hai.

book_ref.quote: This method is especially useful since the by-products (HCl and SO₂) are gases

blocks.prompt:
12 Write equations for the reaction of ethanol with (i) PBr₃ (ii) PCl₅.
(Ethanol ke (i) PBr₃ (ii) PCl₅ ke saath reactions ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) 3CH₃–CH₂–OH + PBr₃ → 3CH₃–CH₂–Br + H₃PO₃
(ii) CH₃–CH₂–OH + PCl₅ → CH₃–CH₂–Cl + POCl₃ + HCl
Dono mein –OH group halo group se badal jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Phosphorus trihalides or phosphorus pentahalides react with alcohols

blocks.prompt:
13 What happens when ethanol is heated with potassium bromide and sulphuric acid? Write the equation.
(Ethanol ko potassium bromide aur sulphuric acid ke saath garam karne par kya hota hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acid pehle KBr se HBr banata hai, phir HBr ethanol ko bromoethane mein badalta hai:
CH₃–CH₂–OH + KBr + H₂SO₄ → CH₃–CH₂–Br + H₂O + KHSO₄

book_ref.quote: The acid first reacts with potassium bromide to give hydrogen bromide

blocks.prompt:
14 Give reason: phosphoric acid is preferred to sulphuric acid in preparing iodoalkanes.
(Wajah batayein: iodoalkanes banane mein sulphuric acid ke bajaye phosphoric acid behtar hai.)
blocks.explanation: Phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄) kamzor oxidizing agent hai, is liye iodide ions ko iodine mein kam badalta hai. Is tarah iodide iodoalkane banane ke liye mojood rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Phosphoric acid is preferably used to prepare iodoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
15 Which organobromine compound is mainly given off by marine algae, and what is its effect on the atmosphere?
(Samundari algae zyada tar kaun sa organobromine compound kharij karti hain, aur is ka fiza par kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samundari algae aur phytoplankton samundar ke bromide ko volatile organobromides mein badalte hain, zyada tar bromomethane (CH₃Br) aur bromoform (CHBr₃). Yeh bromine ko stratosphere tak le jate hain aur ozone ki kami mein hissa dalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The organobromine compound that marine algae and phytoplankton mainly give off

blocks.prompt:
16 Which factor mainly decides the reactivity of halogenoalkanes? Give the order of reactivity.
(Halogenoalkanes ki reactivity ka sab se bara factor kaun sa hai? Reactivity ki tarteeb likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Carbon–halogen bond ki mazbooti: jitna kamzor bond, utni aasaani se tootta hai aur molecule utna reactive. Tarteeb: R–I > R–Br > R–Cl > R–F.

book_ref.quote: the strength of carbon halogen bond is the main factor which decides the reactivity of haloalkanes

blocks.prompt:
17 Using the bond energies C – Cl 346 kJ/mol and C – I 228 kJ/mol, explain which of chloroethane and iodoethane is more reactive.
(C – Cl 346 kJ/mol aur C – I 228 kJ/mol bond energies se batayein ke chloroethane aur iodoethane mein kaun zyada reactive hai.)
blocks.explanation: C – I bond 346 – 228 = 118 kJ/mol kamzor hai, is liye aasaani se tootta hai. Is liye iodoethane chloroethane se zyada reactive hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 21.1 Bond energies of different C-X bonds

blocks.prompt:
18 Show the partial charges in a halogenoalkane molecule R – X. Which part is attacked by a nucleophile?
(Halogenoalkane molecule R – X mein partial charges dikhayein. Nucleophile kis hisse par hamla karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: R–Cδ+ – Xδ–: halogen se jure carbon par partial positive aur halogen par partial negative charge hai. Nucleophile δ+ carbon par hamla karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A halogenoalkane molecule (R – X) consists of two parts

blocks.prompt:
19 Besides bond strength, name three other factors that may affect the reactivity of halogenoalkanes.
(Bond ki mazbooti ke ilawa halogenoalkanes ki reactivity par asar dalne wale teen aur factors ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bond polarity, steric hindrance (jagah ki rukawat) aur inductive effect.

book_ref.quote: Some other factors which may affect the reactivity of halogenoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
20 Why can halogenoalkanes undergo two different types of reactions? Name them.
(Halogenoalkanes do mukhtalif qisam ke reactions kyun kar sakte hain? Un ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: C–X bond polar hai, is liye is ka carbon electrophilic centre hai jis par nucleophile hamla kar sakta hai (nucleophilic substitution, SN). Ya base saath wale carbon ke hydrogen par hamla karke HX nikal deta hai (elimination, E) aur alkene banti hai.

book_ref.quote: The carbon of C-X acts as an electrophilic centre

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between nucleophilic substitution and elimination reactions of halogenoalkanes.
(Halogenoalkanes ke nucleophilic substitution aur elimination reactions mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono qisam mein farq:

book_ref.quote: Those reactions in which the halogen is replaced by some other atom or a group

rows: Halogen ki jagah koi aur atom ya group aata hai
Halogenoalkane se HX nikalta hai
Hamla karne wala nucleophile, electrophilic carbon par
Hamla karne wala base, β-hydrogen par
Product: substituted compound (maslan alcohol)
Product: alkene

blocks.prompt:
22 In the reaction OH⁻ + CH₃–Br → CH₃–OH + Br⁻, identify the attacking nucleophile, the substrate, the substituted product and the leaving group.
(Reaction OH⁻ + CH₃–Br → CH₃–OH + Br⁻ mein attacking nucleophile, substrate, substituted product aur leaving group pehchanein.)
blocks.explanation: Attacking nucleophile: OH⁻; substrate molecule: CH₃–Br; substituted product: CH₃–OH; leaving group: Br⁻.

book_ref.quote: Nucleophilic substitution reaction (original drawing

blocks.prompt:
23 Name the two processes involved in nucleophilic substitution. How do they decide whether the mechanism is SN1 or SN2?
(Nucleophilic substitution ke do processes ke naam likhein. Yeh kaise tay karte hain ke mechanism SN1 hai ya SN2?)
blocks.explanation: Processes: leaving group ka nikalna (C – X bond tootna) aur nucleophile ka hamla (C – Nu bond banna). Dono aik qadam mein saath hon to SN2; pehle bond toote aur doosre qadam mein naya bond bane to SN1.

book_ref.quote: Nucleophilic substitution reactions on alkyl halides involve two main processes

blocks.prompt:
24 From which direction does the nucleophile attack in an SN2 reaction? What happens to the C – X bond at that time?
(SN2 reaction mein nucleophile kis taraf se hamla karta hai? Us waqt C – X bond ke saath kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleophile leaving group ke mukhalif taraf se electrophilic carbon par hamla karta hai. Jaise hi hamla shuru ho, C – X bond tootna shuru hota hai; banne aur tootne ki had barabar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It attacks from the side which is opposite to the leaving group

blocks.prompt:
25 Write the rate equation for an SN2 reaction and state its order.
(SN2 reaction ki rate equation likhein aur is ka order batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate = k[alkyl halide]¹[nucleophile]¹; order = 1 + 1 = 2. Aam SN2 reaction second order hai kyun ke rate alkyl halide aur nucleophile dono ki concentration par hai.

book_ref.quote: Kinetic studies of the reactions involving SN2 mechanism

blocks.prompt:
26 An SN2 reaction has k = 1.6 × 10⁻³ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹. Calculate its rate when [alkyl halide] = 0.050 mol dm⁻³ and [OH⁻] = 0.040 mol dm⁻³.
(SN2 reaction ka k = 1.6 × 10⁻³ dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ hai. [alkyl halide] = 0.050 mol dm⁻³ aur [OH⁻] = 0.040 mol dm⁻³ par rate nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate = k[alkyl halide][OH⁻] = 1.6 × 10⁻³ × 0.050 × 0.040 = 3.2 × 10⁻⁶ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹

book_ref.quote: Mathematically, the rate can be expressed as:

blocks.prompt:
27 Chloromethane reacts with OH⁻ by SN2, not SN1. Name the reason given in the chapter.
(Chloromethane OH⁻ ke saath SN2 se react karta hai, SN1 se nahi. Chapter mein di gayi wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Steric (jagah ki) wajah: primary (ya methyl) halide mein substrate carbon par H atoms (ya sirf aik carbon) hain, is liye nucleophile peechhe se aasaani se pohanch jata hai. Primary monohalogenoalkanes hamesha SN2 follow karte hain.

book_ref.quote: This is due to steric reasons, as in primary monohalogenoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
28 Write the two steps of the SN1 reaction of 2-bromo-2-methylpropane with OH⁻.
(2-bromo-2-methylpropane ke OH⁻ ke saath SN1 reaction ke do qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Qadam 1 (aahista, reversible ionization): (CH₃)₃C–Br ⇌ (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Br⁻
Qadam 2 (tez): (CH₃)₃C⁺ + OH⁻ → (CH₃)₃C–OH

book_ref.quote: This step provides a carbocation as an intermediate

blocks.prompt:
29 In which solvents does the ionization step of an SN1 reaction take place, and what intermediate does it give?
(SN1 reaction ka ionization step kin solvents mein hota hai aur kaun sa intermediate deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkyl halide aqueous acetone ya aqueous ethyl alcohol mein reversible tor par ionize hota hai aur carbocation intermediate (aur halide ion) deta hai.

book_ref.quote: in the presence of aqueous acetone or aqueous ethyl alcohol

blocks.prompt:
30 Why is the first step of the SN1 mechanism the rate-determining step?
(SN1 mechanism ka pehla qadam rate-determining step kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle qadam mein covalent bond tootta hai, is liye yeh doosre qadam (ions ka milna, jo energy ke lehaz se aasaan hai) se aahista hai. Sab se aahista qadam rate tay karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The first step is, therefore, called the rate-determining step

blocks.prompt:
31 Why is SN1 called unimolecular? Write its rate equation.
(SN1 ko unimolecular kyun kehte hain? Is ki rate equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate-determining step mein sirf aik molecule (alkyl halide) hissa leta hai. Rate = k[alkyl halide]; yeh first order hai.

book_ref.quote: The mechanism is called unimolecular because only one molecule takes part in the rate-determining step

blocks.prompt:
32 In an SN1 reaction the concentration of the nucleophile is made four times. What happens to the rate? Explain.
(SN1 reaction mein nucleophile ki concentration chaar guna kar di jaye to rate par kya asar hoga? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate nahi badlega. SN1 mein Rate = k[alkyl halide]; nucleophile sirf tez doosre qadam mein hissa leta hai, is liye rate equation mein nahi aata.

book_ref.quote: Reactions involving SN1 mechanism show first order kinetics

blocks.prompt:
33 Give two reasons why 2-chloro-2-methylpropane follows the SN1 mechanism.
(2-chloro-2-methylpropane SN1 mechanism kyun follow karta hai? Do wajahein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Ionization step mein mustaqil tertiary carbocation banta hai. (2) Electrophilic carbon par teen bhaari methyl groups nucleophile ko leaving group ke peechhe se hamla karne nahi dete, is liye SN2 ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Moreover three bulky groups attached with the electrophilic carbon

blocks.prompt:
34 Arrange the carbocations in order of stability and explain the order.
(Carbocations ko stability ki tarteeb mein likhein aur tarteeb ki wajah samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: Tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl carbocation. Har alkyl group positive carbon ki taraf electrons dhakelta hai (positive inductive effect, +I); jitne kam alkyl groups, utna kam +I aur utni kam stability.

book_ref.quote: Tertiary carbocations are more stable than secondary carbocations

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Positive carbon par electrons ki kami hai. CH₃ groups apne electrons us ki taraf dhakel kar yeh kami poori karte hain. Tertiary mein teen CH₃ hain, is liye woh sab se mustaqil hai; methyl carbocation mein koi CH₃ nahi, is liye sab se kam.

blocks.prompt:
35 Compare the SN1 and SN2 mechanisms in terms of number of steps, molecularity and kinetics.
(SN1 aur SN2 mechanisms ka qadmon ki tadaad, molecularity aur kinetics ke lehaz se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mechanisms ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Since in this mechanism, the reaction takes place in only one step

rows: Do qadam; carbocation intermediate banta hai
Aik qadam; koi intermediate nahi
Unimolecular: rate-determining step mein aik molecule
Bimolecular: aik hi qadam mein do molecules
First order: Rate = k[alkyl halide]
Second order: Rate = k[alkyl halide][nucleophile]
Tertiary halogenoalkanes follow karte hain
Primary halogenoalkanes follow karte hain

blocks.prompt:
36 Define β-elimination with one example.
(β-elimination ki definition misaal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: β-Elimination woh reaction hai jis mein base halogenoalkane ke β-carbon ka hydrogen aur saath wale carbon ka halogen hata deta hai aur alkene banti hai. Misaal: bromoethane base ke saath ethene + H–Base + Br⁻ deta hai.

book_ref.quote: is a reaction in which a hydrogen atom attached to the β-carbon of the alkyl halide

blocks.prompt:
37 On what basis are elimination reactions divided into E2 and E1?
(Elimination reactions ko E2 aur E1 mein kis bunyad par taqseem kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Halogen ke nikalne ke waqt ki bunyad par. Agar halogen aur β-hydrogen aik qadam mein saath niklein to E2; agar pehle halogen nikle (aahista ionization se carbocation) aur doosre qadam mein β-hydrogen hate to E1.

book_ref.quote: The removal of the halogen takes place either simultaneously or after the removal of the hydrogen atom

blocks.prompt:
38 Write the E2 mechanism for bromoethane in words and give its rate equation.
(Bromoethane ka E2 mechanism alfaaz mein likhein aur rate equation dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aik qadam mein base CH₃–CH₂–Br ke β-hydrogen par hamla karta hai, C–H ke electrons C=C banate hain aur Br, Br⁻ ban kar nikalta hai: products ethene, H–Base aur Br⁻.
Rate = k[alkyl halide]¹[base]¹, order = 2

book_ref.quote: The single step E2 elimination mechanism is given below

blocks.prompt:
39 Write the two steps of the E1 reaction of 2-bromo-2-methylpropane.
(2-bromo-2-methylpropane ke E1 reaction ke do qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Qadam 1 (aahista): (CH₃)₃C–Br ⇌ (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Br⁻ (3° carbocation)
Qadam 2 (tez): base β-hydrogen hatata hai: (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Base⁻ → (CH₃)₂C=CH₂ (2-methylpropene) + H–Base

book_ref.quote: In E1 mechanism, like SN1 mechanism

blocks.prompt:
40 In an E2 reaction, [alkyl halide] = 0.20 mol dm⁻³ and [base] = 0.30 mol dm⁻³. If both are doubled, by what factor does the rate change?
(E2 reaction mein [alkyl halide] = 0.20 mol dm⁻³ aur [base] = 0.30 mol dm⁻³ hai. Dono double kar diye jayein to rate kitna guna badlega?)
blocks.explanation: Rate = k[alkyl halide][base]. Naya rate / purana rate = (2 × 2) = 4, yani rate 4 guna ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: E2 reaction is bimolecular and the rate of this reaction depends upon the concentrations of the alkyl halide

blocks.prompt:
41 Which elimination mechanism is followed by primary, secondary and tertiary halogenoalkanes?
(Primary, secondary aur tertiary halogenoalkanes kaun sa elimination mechanism follow karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Primary aam tor par E2, tertiary E1, aur secondary solvent ke intikhab ke mutabiq E2 aur E1 dono follow karte hain.

book_ref.quote: However, secondary halogenoalkanes can show both E2 and E1 reactions

blocks.prompt:
42 Compare the SN2 and E2 reactions of a halogenoalkane.
(Halogenoalkane ke SN2 aur E2 reactions ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono aik qadam wale reactions ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Like nucleophilic substitution, the elimination reactions can follow two types of mechanism

rows: Reagent nucleophile ban kar electrophilic carbon par hamla karta hai
Reagent base ban kar β-hydrogen par hamla karta hai
Halogen badal jata hai; substitution product banta hai
H aur X nikalte hain; alkene banti hai
Rate = k[alkyl halide][nucleophile]
Rate = k[alkyl halide][base]
Bimolecular, second order
Bimolecular, second order

blocks.prompt:
43 Write the substitution and the elimination reactions of bromoethane with sodium hydroxide, stating the conditions.
(Bromoethane ke sodium hydroxide ke saath substitution aur elimination reactions conditions ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Substitution (aqueous NaOH): CH₃CH₂Br + NaOH → CH₃CH₂OH + NaBr
Elimination (alcohol mein NaOH): CH₃CH₂Br + NaOH → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O + NaBr
Dono zyada temperature par reflux mein kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: A halogenoalkane reacts with aqueous sodium hydroxide to give both substitution and elimination products

blocks.prompt:
44 How would you convert bromoethane into (i) ethanol (ii) ethene using sodium hydroxide?
(Sodium hydroxide se bromoethane ko (i) ethanol (ii) ethene mein kaise badlenge?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Bromoethane ko aqueous NaOH ke saath reflux mein garam karein: OH⁻ nucleophile ban kar substitution se ethanol banata hai.
(ii) Bromoethane ko alcohol mein NaOH ke saath garam karein: OH⁻ base ban kar elimination se ethene + H₂O + NaBr banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Bromoethane reacts with aqueous sodium hydroxide to give ethanol as well as ethene

blocks.prompt:
45 Why is the reaction of a halogenoalkane with sodium hydroxide carried out under reflux?
(Halogenoalkane aur sodium hydroxide ka reaction reflux mein kyun kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reaction ke liye zyada temperature chahiye aur products volatile (jaldi urne wale) hain. Reflux bhaap ko wapis flask mein condense kar deta hai, is liye volatile products zaya nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: The reaction takes place at higher temperature under reflux conditions

blocks.prompt:
46 Why does potassium cyanide give a substitution product rather than an alkene with halogenoalkanes?
(Potassium cyanide halogenoalkanes ke saath alkene ke bajaye substitution product kyun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyanide ion (CN⁻) taaqatwar nucleophile magar kamzor base hai. Yeh β-hydrogen ke bajaye electrophilic carbon par hamla karta hai, is liye nitrile (substitution product) banta hai.

book_ref.quote: Since cyanide ion (CN⁻) is a strong nucleophile but a weak base

blocks.prompt:
47 Write the equation for the reaction of bromoethane with ethanolic KCN and name the product.
(Bromoethane ke ethanolic KCN ke saath reaction ki equation likhein aur product ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
CH₃–CH₂–Br + KCN —(alcohol, reflux)→ CH₃–CH₂–C≡N + KBr
Product propanenitrile (propane nitrile) hai.

book_ref.quote: Bromoethane reacts with potassium cyanide to give propane nitrile

blocks.prompt:
48 How does the reaction with KCN increase the length of a carbon chain? Explain with bromoethane.
(KCN ke saath reaction carbon chain ki lambai kaise barhata hai? Bromoethane se samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation: CN⁻ ion Br ki jagah leta hai aur apna aik carbon saath laata hai: bromoethane (2 C) ethanolic KCN ke saath reflux mein propanenitrile, CH₃CH₂C≡N (3 C), deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The reaction is typically carried out by heating the halogenoalkane

blocks.prompt:
49 Write the equation for the first step of the reaction of ammonia with bromoethane. Why does ammonia react?
(Ammonia aur bromoethane ke reaction ke pehle qadam ki equation likhein. Ammonia kyun react karti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ammonia achha nucleophile hai; N ka lone pair C₂H₅–Br ke carbon par hamla karta hai:
NH₃ + C₂H₅–Br → C₂H₅–NH₂ (ethanamine) + HBr

book_ref.quote: Ammonia is a good nucleophile and it reacts with halogenoalkanes

blocks.prompt:
50 Why does the reaction of ammonia with bromoethane give a mixture of amines?
(Ammonia aur bromoethane ke reaction se amines ka mixture kyun banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har bani hui amine ke N par lone pair hota hai aur woh bhi nucleophile hai, is liye ammonia se bromoethane ke liye muqabla karti hai: ethanamine → N-ethylethanamine → N,N-diethylethanamine → quaternary ammonium salt. Amine ki qisam miqdaar ke qaboo par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt:
52 In the silver nitrate test for halogenoalkanes, what are the roles of water and ethanol?
(Halogenoalkanes ke silver nitrate test mein paani aur ethanol ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ethanol halogenoalkane ko ghoolne mein madad deta hai. Paani nucleophile ban kar halide ion ki jagah leta hai:
CH₃–CH₂–X + H–OH → CH₃–CH₂–OH + H⁺ + X⁻
Azad X⁻ phir Ag⁺ se react karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This reaction is carried out in a mixture of water and ethanol

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation:

blocks.prompt:
54 Three test tubes contain 1-chlorobutane, 1-bromobutane and 1-iodobutane with aqueous ethanolic AgNO₃. In what order do the precipitates appear? Why?
(Teen test tubes mein 1-chlorobutane, 1-bromobutane aur 1-iodobutane aqueous ethanolic AgNO₃ ke saath hain. Precipitates kis tarteeb se aayenge? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Tarteeb: pehle 1-iodobutane (AgI, chamakdar peela), phir 1-bromobutane (AgBr, cream peela), aur 1-chlorobutane (AgCl, safaid) bohat der se. Jitna jaldi precipitate, utna reactive halogenoalkane; C–I bond sab se kamzor hai.

blocks.prompt:
55 How can you distinguish between bromoethane and iodoethane using aqueous ethanolic silver nitrate?
(Aqueous ethanolic silver nitrate se bromoethane aur iodoethane mein farq kaise karenge?)
blocks.explanation: Har aik ko aqueous ethanolic AgNO₃ ke saath garam karein. Bromoethane AgBr ka cream peela precipitate deta hai; iodoethane AgI ka chamakdar peela precipitate deta hai jo zyada jaldi aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
56 How is chlorobenzene prepared from benzene? Write the equation and name the type of reaction.
(Benzene se chlorobenzene kaise banaya jata hai? Equation likh kar reaction ki qisam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Benzene room temperature par anhydrous FeCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein chlorine se react karta hai:
C₆H₆ + Cl₂ —(FeCl₃)→ C₆H₅Cl + HCl
Yeh electrophilic aromatic substitution reaction hai.

book_ref.quote: Halogenoarenes like chlorobenzene and bromobenzene are prepared by reacting benzene

blocks.prompt:
57 Write the equation for the preparation of bromobenzene from benzene, giving the catalyst and conditions.
(Benzene se bromobenzene banane ki equation catalyst aur conditions ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
C₆H₆ + Br₂ —(anhydrous FeBr₃, room temperature)→ C₆H₅Br + HBr
Yeh electrophilic aromatic substitution hai.

book_ref.quote: The reaction is called electrophilic aromatic substitution reaction

blocks.prompt:
58 Why does the carbon atom attached to the halogen in a halogenoalkane act as an electrophile?
(Halogenoalkane mein halogen se jura carbon electrophile kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity ke farq se us carbon par partial positive charge aa jata hai. Yeh electron ki kami wala carbon nucleophiles ko hamle ki dawat deta hai, jis se nucleophilic substitution reactions hote hain.

book_ref.quote: a partial positive charge is developed on the carbon atom attached to the halogen making it an electrophile

blocks.prompt:
59 Why is the C—Cl bond in chlorobenzene stronger than the C–Cl bond in chloroethane?
(Chlorobenzene ka C—Cl bond chloroethane ke C–Cl bond se mazboot kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorobenzene mein chlorine ka lone pair aromatic ring mein phail jata hai. Is se C—Cl bond mein jazvi double bond khasoosiyat aati hai, is liye yeh mazboot aur torna mushkil hai. Chloroethane mein aisa phailao nahi.

book_ref.quote: The carbon-halogen bond is stronger due to the partial double-bond character

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Lone pair ring mein phailne se C aur Cl ke darmiyan electrons aik bond se thore zyada ho jate hain (partial double bond). Zyada bond = zyada mazbooti, is liye nucleophile is bond ko aasaani se nahi tor sakta.

61 Why has the use of DDT been restricted, and why do some developing countries still face a problem from its removal?
(DDT ka istemal kyun mehdood kiya gaya, aur is ke hatne se kuch taraqqi pazeer mulkon ko kya masla hua?)
blocks.explanation: DDT mahol mein der tak baqi rehta hai, is liye taraqqi yafta mulkon mein is ka istemal mehdood ya mamnoo hua.
